scope: Three unidimensional dichotomous IRT operations covering bounded1PL/2PL/3PL calibration,characteristic/information curves,and posterior EAP scoring. Partial JMP19.2 Item Analysis numerical coverage,separate from classical Cronbach item_reliability.
integration_status: Public execute/formal Rust tests and matching native SQL PASS; bounded partial contracts only

common_contract.finite_data: Finite nonempty rectangular numeric matrix<=10000rows,128columns,1000000cells;fit<=2000rows and item counts2..12for1PL,3..12for2PL,5..12for3PL. Parameters<=16384finite doubles.
common_contract.frequency: Optional final frequency column integer0..1000000. Zero-frequency rows are validated then ignored. Identical response patterns collapse. Effective frequency excludes allmissing omitted patterns, must exceed kind*items+1and be<=10000000. No fractional case weights.
common_contract.missing: NaN/SQLNULL are not response missing values; finite-1sentinel requires policy1incorrect or2omit. Default0reject. JMP missing->incorrect is matched only with policy1; omission is an explicit extension.
common_contract.assumptions: One latent standard-normal ability,positive item discrimination,conditional local item independence. Ability location/scale fixed0/1;no learned person distribution. No automatic diagnostics prove substantive unidimensionality/local independence.
common_contract.model_parameterization: P_j(theta)=c_j+(1-c_j)*sigmoid(a_j*(theta-b_j));D=1.1PL fixes a1,c0;2PL fixes c0;3PL estimates c in[0,cmax].
common_contract.bounds: Difficulty[-8,8],a[.05,5]numerical guards;contact prevents combined convergence. Guessing bound0..cmax(.01..0.8)defines constrained3PL model. Active zero/upper guessing coefficients have null SE/covariance rows;other uncertainty conditions on that face.
common_contract.penalty: Explicit lambda/2*sum(c_j^2)on TOTAL log likelihood,not average. Returned penalized_log_likelihood=LL-penalty. It is not asserted to reproduce JMP proprietary guessing-penalty formula. Scaling all frequencies and lambda equally preserves estimates.
common_contract.identification: Each item needs both observed classes.2PLrequires>=3items,3PL>=5;effectiveN>parameter_count+1. These are preconditions,not generic/global-identification proofs. Positive definite observed free information required for combined convergence;negative/nearzero relative eigenvalues<=1e-10yield information_identifiedfalse.
common_contract.quadrature: Fit optimized at requested oddq11..81;reportedLL,posterior pattern moments,andinformation useq+8<=89. optimizer_gradient_quadrature_order names lowq;reported_likelihood_quadrature_order andinformation_quadrature_order name highq. ChecktotalLLdelta<=max(tol,1e-9)*(1+absLL)and eachpatternlogprobdelta<=max(tol,1e-9)*(1+abslogprob). Consistency is not rigorous error bound.
common_contract.convergence: Combined converged=optimizer_converged&&quadrature_converged&&!numerical_guard_bound&&information_identified. Optimizer uses average penalized NLL gradient tolerance. Local multistart search,not global proof. Remaining finite iterates are diagnostic.
common_contract.inference: parameter_covariance/standard_errors are null unless combined convergence;AIC/BIC also requirelambda0. information_identified/minimum_information_eigenvalue may still diagnose local curvature of a failed iterate. inference_valid reports validated converged curvature availability. Lambda>0uncertainty_kind explicitly denotes penalized-objective curvature,not MLE sampling covariance or a sandwich estimator. No p-values/CIs or boundary-mixture tests.
common_contract.covariance_order: Difficulties,then original-unit discriminations if2/3PL,then guessing if3PL. Hessian differentiates integrated scores in b,loga,c;inverse free block transformed by da/dloga=a. Active guessing rows/columns null;free stencil shrinks to25%of distance tobounds and rejects ifunresolvable.
common_contract.portable_layout: [1,kind1/2/3,items,missing_policy,saved_odd_q, a0,b0,c0,a1,b1,c1,...]. Savedq=fitq+8<=89;length5+3J<=41. Portable manual fixed-item models allow1..12items;fit still usesminimum2/3/5.
common_contract.score: EAP under fixed N(0,1),not JMPpersonMLE. Score compares savedq andq+8<=97;maximum of logprob/mean/variance order differences must be<=1e-7*(1+abslogprob). Completely omitted response patterns exactlyprior. Conditions on supplied item parameters.
common_contract.sharp_tail_limit: Measured12items,a5,b8,allcorrect,q81/89 returns mean8.39323 versus independentquad8.41561 and variance.04058 versus.03433;quadrature_convergedfalse withdelta.07225. Such returned values are diagnostic and must not be treated as converged precision. No adaptive integration fallback.
common_contract.resource: Nominal collapsed_patterns*items*q*starts*maxiter<=500000000;maxiter<=2000,1or3starts,line search<=50trials,Jacobi<=64sweeps with separate boundedworkcheck. Nominal preflight is not cumulative CPU instruction count;observed-information evaluations are additional bounded work. Output matrices fit<=12items and<=10000curverows.
common_contract.JMP_gaps: Bounded local optimizer,explicit ridge penalty andposterior EAP scoring differ from JMPdefaults/abilityformula. NoGUI,model-selection/reportplots,multidimensional/polytomous response,latent regression,multiple-groupDIF,equating/adaptive testing,fullfitindices orWald/LR inference.

operations.description: Bounded1PL/2PL/3PL marginal item likelihood under fixed N(0,1): item rows,optional last integer frequency; [model=2,freq=0,missing=0,maxiter=300,tol=1e-6,oddq=41,cmax=.5,guess_penalty=0].
operations.data: Binary item columns, optional -1missing sentinel with explicit policy and optional final integer frequency. <=2000 rows;1PL2..12items,2PL3..12,3PL5..12. Each item needs correct/incorrect effective observations. No person/item covariates.
operations.estimator: Fixed standard normal ability and independent Bernoulli items conditional on ability. Normal Gauss-Hermite MML with analytic integrated scores and bounded projected BFGS;1start1PL,3starts2/3PL. Discrimination exp(loga)>0,1PL a1/c0;2PL c0. Difficulty[-8,8],discrimination[.05,5]are numerical guard bounds and prevent combined convergence on contact. Guessing[0,cmax]is the explicitly constrained3PL model;active guessing faces may legitimately converge. Local optimum only. Frequencies collapse identical patterns; allcorrect/allincorrect people contribute to calibration.
unsupported: multidimensional or polytomous IRT,latent regression,group DIF/equating
conditional/joint ML and exact JMP optimizer or guessing-penalty equivalence
person ML ability estimates or full item parameter CI/Wald/LR inference

operations.description: Saved IRT characteristic/information curves: scalar ability rows and unchanged model_parameters; D1 logistic probabilities,individual/test Fisher information.
operations.data: One finite numeric ability per row,<=10000rows.
args: unchanged model_parameters returned by irt_fit; portable layout in common_contract
operations.estimator: P=c+(1-c)*sigmoid(a*(theta-b)),D=1. Conditional Bernoulli Fisher information=(dP/dtheta)^2/(P(1-P)),summed across items. Stable boundary formulas give zero information at saturated tails. Also returns expected total score and conditional total-score variance.
unsupported: ability uncertainty propagation or parameter uncertainty bands

operations.description: Posterior EAP ability scoring: binary item response rows,optional -1missing under saved policy,and unchanged model_parameters; finite extreme scores with quadrature diagnostics.
operations.data: Same ordered item columns as fitted model,without frequency;<=10000rows. Portable fixed-item models may contain1..12items.
operations.estimator: Posterior mean/variance under fixed N(0,1) prior,conditional on supplied item parameters. Uses savedq andq+8normal Hermite rules,returns higher-order moments/logpatternprobability. Both allcorrect/allincorrect patterns have proper finite EAP;allmissing under omission returns exactly mean0/variance1/logprobability0. This differs from JMP person-MLE ability scoring,which omits extreme patterns. Item parameters remain fixed.
unsupported: posterior intervals/plausible values or item-parameter uncertainty
automatic adaptive quadrature; sharp tails may remain unresolved and flagged
